resources.string: Fractional zoom and per-frame configuration generations. Buffer valid only during the callback. Apply after switching.
For algorithms accepting only byte[]. The SDK copies each frame into reused arrays; do not retain across callbacks. No per-frame zoom evidence. Apply after switching.
Borrowed buffer with integer zoom only. Switching from fractional zoom resets to 1×. Apply changes. No V2 zoom session or per-frame generation.
V1 has no session zoom confirmation; frames and size only
Larger zoom narrows the view. V1 accepts integers only; Apply restarts export with the new zoom.
No per-frame zoom confirmation; use actual frame dimensions

1× is the base view; a larger zoom narrows the view. Apply your selection, or use Apply zoom only during preview.
Original APIs: takePhoto / startRecord. Use Set zoom to change zoom.

New APIs: photos use CameraShareConfigV2, a request callback and JPEG quality; recording keeps RecordConfig and adds fractional zoom and a watermark. Settings apply to the next request. During recording, use Set zoom. Unsupported services report an error without automatic fallback.
Settings reset: 1×, JPEG 90, resolution reuse off, watermark off. The current recording is unchanged.
LEGACY: takePhoto / startRecord with original parameters.
OPTIONS_V2: CameraMediaOptions.takePhoto / startRecord require the matching service capability. Adjust parameters in Settings; unsupported services do not fall back automatically.
